translations.web: They feared Yahweh, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.
translations.bsb: They worshiped the LORD, but they also served their own gods according to the customs of the nations from which they had been carried away.
translations.kjv: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
translations.asv: They feared Jehovah, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.
